summary: Say which rebuild took a replication projection chunk's writer loan: inside incremental, long holds of that loan in the writer-hold row of GET /v1/client/request-latency gain the stages rebuild-base, rebuild-tree, rebuild-part and rebuild-planning, and a rebuilt map counting the aggregates rebuilt and the claims they replayed, by stage

replay.detail: Projection results, ordering, errors and the frontier are unchanged; the stages only time the existing rebuilds, and the counts come from claim lists the rebuilds already read.

schema.detail: In-memory accounting only; no database changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; members may upgrade in any order.

compatibility.detail: Additive: the projection loan's long_holds rows can carry four more stage names and a rebuilt map. Every other row is unchanged. The cost is two clock reads per rebuilt aggregate and one lock per rebuild count; outside a projection loan each mark is one thread-local read.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart to install the build; no extra interruption.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary freely; nothing is persisted.
